title: calliandra haematostoma var. genuina
intro: Calliandra haematostoma var. genuina, commonly known as the Red Powder Puff, is a flowering plant species native to tropical regions. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra haematostoma var. genuina include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory congestion, and as an anti-inflammatory, reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
